description.p: SnapPDF organizes PDFs from unrelated folders into one local workspace with nested projects, tabs, recents, search, annotations, offline OCR, Reader mode, Presentation mode, and an optional ChatGPT or Gemini study panel for questions about selected text, figures, and documents.

Documents remain in their original filesystem locations. SnapPDF does not require imports, duplicate files, or cloud storage. A provider connection is used only when the optional study panel is enabled.
Adds the study chat, direct text and PDF-region handoff, model selection, and checksum-verified user-level installation.
